numeric.name: driver_age
numeric.description: Age of the primary driver in years; a fundamental risk factor capturing young/inexperienced and elderly driver risk profiles.

numeric.name: vehicle_age
numeric.description: Age of the insured vehicle in years; older vehicles typically have lower values but higher mechanical failure risk and different repair cost profiles.
numeric.data_quality_note: Max of 68 years is plausible for classic vehicles but worth validating against vehicle_value for consistency.

numeric.name: age_driving_licence
numeric.description: Number of years the driver has held a licence; proxy for driving experience, inversely correlated with risk for younger drivers.
numeric.data_quality_note: Min of 0 may indicate newly licensed drivers; check for implausible combinations with driver_age.

numeric.name: vehicle_value
numeric.description: Market or insured value of the vehicle; key driver of property damage and theft premium adequacy.
numeric.data_quality_note: 0.14% nulls require imputation; max of ~374k suggests high-value outliers that may need capping or log-transformation.

numeric.name: power_to_weight_ratio
numeric.description: Vehicle power relative to weight; proxy for vehicle performance and associated accident severity risk.
numeric.data_quality_note: Min of 0 may indicate data entry errors or electric vehicles; verify zero values.

numeric.name: seats
numeric.description: Number of seats in the vehicle; relates to occupant exposure and vehicle category (passenger car vs. minibus).

numeric.name: liability_exposure
numeric.description: Fractional exposure for liability coverage within the policy period; useful as a secondary exposure or offset adjustment.
numeric.data_quality_note: Min of 0.0027 is very small but plausible for short-term policies.

categorical.name: policy_type
categorical.description: Type of motor insurance policy (e.g., comprehensive, third-party); directly determines coverage scope and expected premium level.

categorical.name: business_type
categorical.description: Indicates whether the policy is new business or a renewal (portfolio); renewal business typically exhibits lower risk due to selection effects.

categorical.name: payment_frequency
categorical.description: Frequency of premium payment (annual, semi-annual, quarterly); may correlate with customer financial profile and lapse risk.

categorical.name: bonus_score
categorical.description: Bonus-malus or driver quality score (Good/Neutral/Bad); direct indicator of historical claims behaviour and future risk.

categorical.name: fuel_type
categorical.description: Type of fuel used by the vehicle (Diesel/Gasoline); associated with vehicle category, usage patterns, and repair costs.
categorical.data_quality_note: 0.36% nulls; impute with mode or treat as a separate 'Unknown' category.

categorical.name: vehicle_brand
categorical.description: Manufacturer brand of the insured vehicle; captures brand-level differences in repair costs, theft attractiveness, and safety ratings.
categorical.data_quality_note: 68 unique brands; rare brands should be grouped into an 'Other' category to ensure statistical credibility.

categorical.name: municipality_type
categorical.description: Classification of the municipality where the vehicle is garaged (e.g., inner city, city, suburban); proxy for traffic density and accident frequency.

categorical.name: circulation_area
categorical.description: Urban or rural circulation area of the vehicle; urban areas typically exhibit higher frequency but lower severity claims.
